description: A low frequency oscillator built on the sn generator function, whose waveshape morphs between sine, square, triangle and sawtooth and everything in between

params.text: Sets the eccentricity of the generator function, -1 to +1, which is what carries the wave from a sine towards a square, a spike or a sawtooth
Multiplies the eccentricity before it is taken through a hyperbolic tangent, 0 to 5, so it is the fine adjustment on the shape
Rotates the generator function, -90 degrees to +90 degrees
Sets the amplitude of the waveform, 0 at the bottom of its travel and 1 at the top
Shifts the generator function sideways, -1 to +1
Shifts the generator function vertically, -1 to +1
Sets the phase offset of the harmonic, -90 degrees to +90 degrees
Multiplies the base frequency by a whole number from 1 to 5
Sets the rate, over whichever of the three ranges the menu has chosen; the default range runs from 0.1Hz to 10Hz and is logarithmic

inputs.text: Added to the frequency knob, 5V covering the knob's whole travel, read one value per poly channel and clamped to the ends of that travel; the number of channels on it is the number the module runs
A rising edge restarts every channel's waveform at the beginning of its cycle

outputs.text: A 25Hz copy of the waveshape for a scope, at ±5V, carrying this module's own wave, the summed wave of the stack, or both, according to the menu
A 10V pulse 1ms long at the start of each cycle of the AUX waveform, to trigger a scope
The low frequency signal itself, ±5V, one poly channel per channel of the frequency input

notes: It is the base of a stack: sn-lfox expanders placed directly against its left or right edge add harmonics to it
AUX is not the LFO. It is a fixed 25Hz copy of the same waveshape meant for a scope, so the shape can be looked at whatever the LFO rate is
menu: range: 0.1-10Hz, 0.02-2Hz, 0.5-25Hz — sets the span of the frequency knob; the first two are logarithmic and the third is linear
k-rate — sets how often the knobs and CV are read to rebuild the waveshape: every sample, or once every 64, 128 or 256 samples
aux-mode: OSC, SUM, POLY — chooses whether AUX carries this module's own monitor wave, the summed wave of the whole stack, or the first on channel 1 and the second on channel 2
aux-gain: 1, ½, ⅓, ¼, ⅕ — scales the summed monitor wave down so a tall stack fits on a scope

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
